"""Load planning for the delivery vans."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Item:
    name: str
    weight_kg: float
    volume_l: float
    quantity: int


def total_weight(items: Sequence[Item]) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    for item in items:
        if item.quantity <= 0:
            continue
        total += item.weight_kg * item.quantity
    return round(total, 3)


def total_volume(items: Sequence[Item]) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    for item in items:
        if item.quantity <= 0:
            continue
        total += item.volume_l * item.quantity
    return round(total, 3)


def fits(items: Sequence[Item], max_weight_kg: float, max_volume_l: float) -> bool:
    return total_weight(items) <= max_weight_kg and total_volume(items) <= max_volume_l
